optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Senior Project Manager, Plant Automation Retrofits

professionalSummary.text: Experienced project professional with five years of hands-on involvement in plant automation retrofit projects within a beverage group's programme, supporting project managers of record in executing instrumentation and control-panel workstreams.
professionalSummary.witness: Project engineer, then workstream manager, on the bottling plant automation retrofit programme of a beverage group for five years, running the instrumentation and the control-panel workstreams within retrofit projects run by the programme's project managers.

professionalSummary.text: Proven ability to plan and track workstreams under the programme's stage-gate method, producing workstream plans, progress reports, and stage-gate inputs that were compiled by the project manager of record into formal submissions.
professionalSummary.witness: Planned and tracked the two workstreams under the programme's stage-gate method, producing the workstream plans, the progress reports and the stage-gate inputs that the project manager of record assembled into the gate submissions.

professionalSummary.text: Documented workstream boundaries, risks, and hand-over conditions at each stage gate, with all documents filed under the project manager of record's submissions.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the workstream boundary notes, the workstream risk registers and the hand-over notes for each stage gate, all filed under the project manager of record's gate submissions.

experienceHighlights.text: Supported plant shutdown windows at four plants as workstream manager, with shutdown plans and decisions held by the project manager of record and plant manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: Supported the plant shutdown windows at four plants as the workstream manager on site, with the shutdown plan and the shutdown decisions held by the project manager of record and the plant manager.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed workstream cost tracking against allocations set by the project manager of record, with no delegated spending authority.
experienceHighlights.witness: Budget responsibility was limited to the workstream cost tracking against the allocation set by the project manager of record; no delegated spending limit was held.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Workstream plan, progress reports, risk register, and hand-over note for gate three of a retrofit project, with programme office document references and project manager of record's signature on gate submissions.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the instrumentation workstream plan and progress reports for one retrofit project, the workstream risk register and the hand-over note for gate three, with the programme office's document references as a verification trail; the gate submissions carry the project manager of record's signature.

skills.witness: Planned and tracked the two workstreams under the programme's stage-gate method, producing the workstream plans, the progress reports and the stage-gate inputs that the project manager of record assembled into the gate submissions.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's role as a workstream manager supporting project managers of record on retrofit projects, including planning workstreams, documenting stage-gate items, and supporting shutdowns, but do not establish that the candidate was the project manager of record signing charters or stage-gate submissions, held the project budget, or directed project engineers as the accountable project manager.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate's role as workstream manager does not meet the requirement of being project manager of record; human review required to assess if candidate can be considered for the role.
